mechanism: An extreme positive half-day return on one major smart-contract chain can attract scarce investor attention and capital away from rival chain ecosystems. The test is whether the attention-shock chain subsequently outperforms an equal-weight basket of rival chain natives over the next half-day.

literature_anchor.title: One Rising Ship Sinks Other Ships: Cross-Chain Negative Spillovers in Crypto Markets
literature_anchor.documented_mechanism: attention-driven capital reallocation / substitution across chain ecosystems
literature_anchor.boundary: The paper documents cross-chain spillovers; this lab tests a separately frozen, executable native-token relative-value translation.

material_difference: Signal is an event-conditioned extreme return in one competing chain native.
Outcome is winner-versus-rival-basket relative value, designed to suppress broad crypto beta.
anti_duplication.repo_search_at_freeze: No prior branch found for cross-chain attention/capital-reallocation/fee-flow equivalents.

market_control: BTCUSDT is downloaded for diagnostics only and does not determine primary signal or PnL.

chronology.holdout_rule: Do not open 2025 outcomes unless the frozen 2022-2024 Discovery gate passes.

source_gate.full_rule: Each symbol has >=46/48 monthly archives, >=11 months in every calendar year, parseable 1h OHLC and no duplicate open_time.
source_gate.limited_rule: Each signal symbol has >=40/48 months and >=9 months in each discovery year; holdout may not open unless 2025 has >=11 months.

signal.attention_shock: current 12h log return >= its own past-only rolling 95th percentile and current return > 0
signal.multi_shock_resolution: If multiple chains qualify at the same boundary, choose the chain with the largest standardized shock = current 12h return / past-only rolling 180-halfday standard deviation.
signal.entry: next half-day begins at the same UTC boundary using the 1h bar OPEN at that boundary
signal.trade: long winner 1.0 notional; short equal-weight basket of the other three chains totaling 1.0 notional

costs.interpretation: Approx. 10 bps round-trip on the long notional plus 10 bps across the short basket; stress doubles this.

no_rescue: No change from 12h to another horizon after outcomes.
No change to winner-long/rivals-short direction after outcomes.
No BTC filter added after outcomes.
